title: Oscillatory Phase Coding Emerges in Adaptive RNNs for Flexible Working Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.06932v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Oscillatory phase coding (OPC) is widely observed in neural systems and has been implicated in cognitive functions such as memory and sequence processing. However, its computational role and neural substrates remain largely unclear. Here, we studied OPC by training recurrent neural networks (RNNs) with adaptation to perform sequence working memory tasks with variable delays. After training, we found that OPC emerges in the RNN spontaneously: the memorized items recur at distinct phases of a shared rhythm, with oscillation amplitude encoding item identity and phase encoding serial order. Ablation studies identified three key elements required for OPC: adaptation in neural dynamics, variable delay in memory retention, and flexibility in reading out information. translated_title: 振荡相位编码在自适应循环神经网络中涌现以实现灵活的工作记忆
translated_abstract: 振荡相位编码（OPC）在神经系统中被广泛观察到，并与记忆和序列处理等认知功能相关。然而，其计算作用和神经基础在很大程度上仍不清楚。本研究通过训练具有适应性的循环神经网络（RNN）执行可变延迟的序列工作记忆任务来研究OPC。训练后，我们发现OPC在RNN中自发涌现：被记忆的项目在共享节律的不同相位上重复出现，其中振荡幅度编码项目身份，而相位编码序列顺序。消融研究确定了OPC所需的三个关键要素：神经动力学中的适应性、记忆保持过程中的可变延迟，以及信息读出的灵活性。神经元类型分析揭示了训练后的RNN中出现了内容细胞和时间细胞，它们分别处理项目身份和序列顺序。循环连接分析……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究发现在具有适应性的循环神经网络中训练可变延迟的序列工作记忆任务时，振荡相位编码会自发涌现，其中振荡幅度编码项目身份、相位编码序列顺序，且该现象依赖于神经适应性、可变延迟和信息读出灵活性三个关键要素。
en_tdlr: Oscillatory phase coding spontaneously emerges in adaptive RNNs trained on variable-delay sequence working memory tasks, with amplitude encoding item identity and phase encoding serial order, and it requires three key elements: neural adaptation, variable delay, and flexible readout.
